sources.quote: 4.2 A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that
Correct, the audit qualifies the company. Part approvals stay as they are.

findings.why: The ASL covers HS-410 for PLT-BEI and Aurelia, but only for SUP-G and SUP-E. Meccanica Chisone (SUP-C) has no approval for this part. Its company-level re-approval on 2026-11-06 does not approve any part (QP-11 4.1).

sources.quote: The supplier shall obtain written approval from Aurelia (PPAP resubmission) before shipping parts
Aurelia shall be notified of every planned change at least 90 days before implementation.

findings.why: HS-410 belongs to PRG-X, which is an Aurelia program. Revision 4 of the Aurelia manual is in force and replaces revision 3. It requires written PPAP approval and 90 days' notice for a change of source. DEV-121 only covers coating thickness and does not cover a source change.

sources.quote: SUP-C,Meccanica Chisone S.r.l.,aluminium extrusions and blanks

findings.why: The drawing requires Steel DC04. Meccanica Chisone is qualified only for aluminium (6061-T6 and 6082-T5) and has no DC04 capability. Its commodity is aluminium extrusions and blanks, not steel stampings.

sources.quote: 4.4 A change of source requires a material certificate (EN 10204 type 3.1) from the new supplier for

findings.why: SUP-C has 3.1 certificates only for 6061-T6 and 6082-T5. There is none for MAT-DC04, which the drawing requires. The supplier quality engineer (E. Gallo) must clarify this.
